verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a model-hosting API, but the pack shows no documented way for a user to run one operation across many items at once (e.g. batch prediction submission or bulk management of predictions or models). The 'batching' mention refers to server-side inference infrastructure the platform manages, and autoscaling is an adjacent capacity feature; neither is a user-facing bulk operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
